text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since the Bamboo Stakes, Sasami
Anshinzawa and
I have continued
winning race after race together.
And
now our final goal, the Sasabari Sho, is
about
to begin!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come! Thinking
back, we've
been through a lot, haven't
we?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
There was the Fan Fest, summer camp,
Valentines
Day, as well as the winter
holidays... The list just
goes on and
on! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
What, having trouble getting your head
in the
game right before the main event?
Don't be
nervous, you'll be fine!
choice_data_list: あったかな……いや、あった気がしてきた？
choice_data_list_en: Was there...? No, now I feel like there was?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, you're my partner! You've been
working
hard with me while still keeping
at your trainer
duties and even doing
solo training!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did! I've been watching
everything you
do! I'm a fan of yours,
after all!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I have full confidence that you'll be the
one to
conquer the Needle Series.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you just how much faith I have
in you
with these needles!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! ☆ Are you ready?!
choice_data_list: 思いっきりやっちゃってください！
あんし～ん第一でお願いします……！
choice_data_list_en: Feel free to go all out!
Peace of mind first, pretty please...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here it comes! Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
See?! I didn't botch it up! You were
always in safe
hands! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if cradled by the sea's anodyne
embrace, I find
the courage to set off
towards the track—the
stage of my final
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh! No, nothing's wrong! Anyways,
aren't you
feeling better now?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
D-don't worry! I know you can do it!
You've come
this far, haven't you?!
choice_data_list: だめだ……あんし～んできない……！
choice_data_list_en: No good... I can't feel at eaaase...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of how I'm feeling, today's
race will
decide the victor. At this point,
I have no choice
but to do what I can.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I always prioritize your safety! ☆ Well,
are you
ready?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here it comes! Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! ☆ Look, your skin's clear and
dewy, and
you look ready for anything
and everything! That
was a great
success, if I say so myself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With my body in perfect condition
thanks to the
acupuncture session, I set
off towards the
track—the stage of my
final showdown.
choice_data_list: すごい！誰にも負ける気がしません！
choice_data_list_en: Incredible! I don't feel like I could lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is it just me, or did that not do
much?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That can't be! Sure, my needle was off
by a teeny
tiny bit, but that shouldn't
have been a
problem! ☆
choice_data_list: あまり変わった気がしなくて
choice_data_list_en: I don't feel like much has changed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still feel doubtful, but regardless, the
victor will
be decided here at today's
race. At this point, I
have no choice but
to do what I can.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Keep it up! Show us your nice and stable
running!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ☆ Such incredible acceleration!
Wait, could
this be the work of who I
think it might be?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ Well, Isami? Liking what you
see? That's
my pride and joy of a partner
out there!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Aw, come on! ☆ I told you to call me
"Beauty
Anshinzawa"! But back to the
point...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: He's a beaut, that's for sure! ♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: She's a beaut, that's for sure! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
All will be well. I'm sure your trainer will
come out
victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That day at the Sasabari Sho, the first to
cross
the finish line amidst an eruption of
cheers turned
out to be none other
than...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... You did it, partner! You came in first place with flying colors! Sob!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You sure did! With this, both our names
will be
forever remembered in the
history of acupunc—
choice_data_list: 安心沢さん……俺、やりました！
安心沢さん……私、やりました！

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, silly me! This isn't the time for this!

<username>,
congratulations
on winning!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let me offer my felicitations as

well—congratulations!
<chrname> is
also over the
moon! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If my performance here today was able
to
positively influence
<chrname>...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then there's no greater reassurance and
joy than
that.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: By the way...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: How exactly did things come to this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna's question is a completely
reasonable and
valid one, and honestly,
I can't blame her for
asking.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, their running form looks off... It's
lacking the
usual worriless gait.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ☆ Wait, could this be the work of
who I
think it might be?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, we got overtaken! This is all
because I
messed up that acupuncture
session!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
What a surprise... I didn't think you'd
actually
acknowledge your own mistake.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's harsh! What, you think I'd
blame my
partner? Even I wouldn't do
that!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
We've been through so much together as
trainer
and racer...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I've watched him every step of the way,
so I know
all too well just how much
effort he's put in!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I've watched her every step of the way,
so I know
all too well just how much
effort she's put in!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It seems like I may have been wrong
about you all
this time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That day at the Sasabari Sho, the first to
cross
the finish line amidst an eruption of
cheers turned
out to be none other
than...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Aww, c'mon! There's no need to be so
depressed!
You did a great job! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It looks like you had trouble breaking
out from
traffic...
choice_data_list: でも……勝ちたかったです
choice_data_list_en: Still... I really wanted to win.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But if you train for more power, it will
help you
make your way through next
time!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! Sure, the Needle Series may
have come
to an end...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But I'd love to keep working with you!
Doesn't
that sound like a wonderful
idea? Let's keep
chasing after our
dreams! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I fell short of the goal Sasami

Anshinzawa and I set our sights on, the
time I
spent with her has definitely been
worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I believe the experience I've
accumulated will
help shape my future
into one of bright hope,
free of worry.
